label: BEING_1 is not a GENUS_1 in the…, from Every GENUS_1 has at least one differentia… and 2 more
meaning: Metaphysics III.3, 998b22-27: every genus has a differentia, every differentia is a being, and a genus is not said of its own differentiae; so being is not a genus (strict sense). The Comparator config also verifies three omission countermodels, one per premise.
